# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b5 — Complete localized setup help

**Opt-in Beta 5 — Home Assistant 2026.10+**

This release addresses the still-untranslated fields and missing descriptions
in the Home Environment Manager setup and options dialogs. It preserves the
existing `air_quality_advisor` integration domain and all stored settings.

## What's improved

- **Every visible field now has an explanation** in both the initial setup
  wizard and the options menu. All **22 advanced thresholds** have their
  own descriptions for the first time, explaining units, practical use,
  ventilation effects and the distinction between operational thresholds
  and medical or legal exposure limits.
- **English and Greek field-by-field guidance** covers thermostat targets,
  occupancy/home/away/sleep behavior, PID gains and timing, native DRY/FAN
  safeguards, humidity and filter/extraction fans, mold calibration and
  optional radon, formaldehyde, noise and ISO 7730 comfort inputs.
- **All 38 supported languages** now include translated field names and
  descriptions instead of inherited English text. Technical terms such as
  PM2.5, CO₂ and PID stay unchanged, as appropriate; other translated help
  uses locale-specific phrases. Native translation quality can still be
  improved with community review.
- **Automatic localization regression tests** prevent any of the existing
  fields from losing their help or copying English on regeneration. This
  final translation stage runs after the older setup generators.

## Install through HACS

Back up your Home Assistant configuration first. Open
[Home Environment Manager in HACS](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/hacs_repository/?owner=Chreece&repository=HA-Home-Environment-Manager&category=integration)
and use **Redownload → Show beta versions → v0.6.0b5** (HACS wording
may vary). Restart Home Assistant so the updated translations reload.

If HACS cannot select this beta, use the attached
`HA-Home-Environment-Manager-v0.6.0b5.zip` for **manual installation**,
extracting `custom_components/air_quality_advisor/` into the HA
configuration directory and restarting. HACS itself installs the tagged
source tree, not this manual ZIP.

For an already configured installation, use **Configure**, not **Add
integration**. All existing entities and settings remain intact.

## Beta safety

This is a software localization/UX update, **not physical HVAC
commissioning**. Automatic compressor-affecting modes, humidifier/fan power,
and direct relays remain separately opt-in and require independent equipment
protections. Unknown room or sleep occupancy does not authorize power OFF.
Window control remains advisory only.

The project remains on **stable v0.5.1** for normal HACS users; beta 5 is
an optional prerelease and does not replace earlier immutable tags.
